# Boise Remodeling Co

> Design-build remodeling for kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home renovations, and room additions in Boise, Idaho and the Treasure Valley.

## About This Business

Boise Remodeling Co is a locally owned design-build remodeling company serving the Treasure Valley. Homeowners work with one accountable team from design and permitting through construction.

- Phone: (208) 555-0100 (update via NEXT_PUBLIC_PHONE before launch)
- Email: hello@boiseremodeling.co
- Address: 2283 N Coopers Hawk Ave, Kuna, ID 83634
- Hours: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
- Service area: Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Nampa, Kuna, Star, Middleton, Caldwell (Ada and Canyon County)
- Licensed, bonded, and insured (Idaho contractor license placeholder)
